episodes.187227: Diurnal heating aided in the development of showers along the interior and western portions of Puerto Rico. The islands were over an area of localized enhanced moisture, but there was no dynamics at the mid and upper levels.
episodes.187356: Isolated waterspouts developed along a cumulus cloud line over Hawk Channel, as lower tropospheric winds were very light and variable.

events.narrative: Flooding was reported at Calle Malasia, intersection with Javillo and Jose Gonzalez streets. The road was closed by emergency managers.

events.county: Hawk Channel From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To Halfmoon Shoal Out To The Reef
events.narrative: A funnel cloud was observed about 5 miles south of Boca Chica Key.  No spray ring was observed.  A second waterspout developed east of the original waterspout.
